items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine is open to freezing the war along current front lines
items.summary: In an ABC News interview published on 23 October, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Kyiv is ready to end the war quickly and is open to a freeze along the present lines, while criticising reduced US support. Ukrinform separately reports he expects Russia to step up ballistic missile attacks as US Patriot supplies fall. Details of any talks remain unconfirmed.
items.why: The shape of any ceasefire drives energy prices, sanctions and supply-chain risk that global employers plan hiring around.

items.title: IDF chief vows to pursue those behind a deadly West Bank shooting
items.summary: Times of Israel's live blog for 23 October leads with the IDF chief visiting the site of a deadly shooting and promising to pursue everyone involved. Casualty details were still developing in the coverage, so treat them as provisional.
items.why: Regional escalation feeds oil prices and risk sentiment that move markets and corporate travel and hiring plans.

items.title: India and Poland aim to double trade by 2030 and open a defence industry dialogue
items.summary: Reported on 22 October (two days ago): after talks between PM Modi and Polish PM Donald Tusk in New Delhi, the two sides set a target of doubling bilateral trade by 2030 and agreed a Defence Industry Dialogue and a counter-terrorism dialogue. Cybersecurity, critical minerals and connectivity were also named. No fresher India story with a verifiable link was found today.
items.why: Trade targets open export and market-entry roles in engineering, defence supply chains and consumer goods that recruit MBAs.

items.title: Canva launches Craft, its first in-house image generation model
items.summary: Reported on 22 October (two days ago): Canva released Craft, trained on its own template library, open to users through Dream Lab and to developers via an API. Its claimed leaderboard ranking is preliminary and self-reported.
items.why: Marketers will be expected to produce on-brand creative with tools like this.

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO drew strong institutional demand ahead of its 23 October close
items.summary: The Week reported on 22 October that the Rs 30,213 crore Jio Platforms issue was fully covered on day two, with overall demand about 4.2 times the shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers bid about 9.9 times and retail about 1.32 times. The Sensex fell more than 700 points that day. Final subscription and listing details were not found, so figures are provisional and from two days ago.
items.why: Heavy demand for a consumer-tech brand shows how much investors pay for scale and brand strength, a useful lens for marketers.

items.title: Uber rolls out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees
items.summary: AI Weekly reports that on 22 October Uber said it is deploying OpenAI's ChatGPT Work company-wide to over 30,000 staff after a pilot with 1,000, calling it its first company-wide agentic platform for knowledge work.
items.why: HR teams are being asked to plan training, role design and policy as AI agents enter everyday work.

items.title: Nvidia unveils Minerva, an operations platform for AI data centres
items.summary: At GTC Berlin Nvidia introduced Minerva, which pulls GPU, networking and job telemetry into one knowledge graph for managing AI factories, according to its live blog (22 to 23 October).
items.why: It shows AI infrastructure is becoming a managed operations product, a growing category for B2B marketing.
